name: align-grid
rationale: Specialized editorial-grid design and measurement knowledge can supplement impeccable; existing UI verification owns execution.
adaptations: Make Swiss styling optional; remove Hyperagent-only tools and automatic publication; repair selector, multi-grid and vacuous baseline checks; use authorized browser tooling and validate missing targets.

name: assess-impact
rationale: A bounded dependency and history investigation fits an existing codebase analyzer; the parent owns persistence and risk acceptance.
adaptations: Retain rubric as reference; replace TypeScript-only searches with repository-aware evidence; label risk scores uncalibrated; test dynamic callers, re-exports and missing tests.

name: audit-code
rationale: Source defines author self-review, not an independent reviewer; reuse qlty and project checks inside shared verification.
adaptations: Separate judgment from executable verdicts; remove automatic fixes, handoffs and upstream-only conventions; review staged and unstaged candidate changes; test real defects and report freshness.

name: audit-plan
rationale: Readiness assessment is reusable planning knowledge; create-spec and the parent conversation already own clarification.
adaptations: Replace mandatory Bigpowers files with project evidence; use structured questions only for unresolved decisions; test imported plans, N/A checks and withheld approval.

name: build-epic
rationale: Durable story lifecycle, checkpoints and repair belong to story mode of one verified-implementation workflow, with delivery separately owned.
adaptations: Replace YAML counters with native state; resolve step-zero threat-model bypass and epic/story scope; remove automatic commits, release and generated sync; test resume and concurrent ownership.

name: change-request
rationale: Negotiating mid-release scope and priority needs parent judgment; deterministic WSJF calculation supports rather than owns the method.
adaptations: Choose capsule paths; use (BV + TC + RR) / Job Size; preserve IDs and active work; validate positive size and dependencies; status seeding is not reconciliation; preserve required placement confirmation.

name: commit-message
rationale: An optional draft-message shortcut can reuse installed commit-work instead of duplicating commit methodology.
adaptations: Separate drafting from stage/commit authority; read actual release configuration; preserve user attribution and signing; remove next_skill writes; draft mode must leave index/history untouched.

name: compose-workflow
rationale: Workflow authoring guidance is a method, not an executable scheduler; reuse Atomic documentation and builtin composition.
adaptations: Treat upstream YAML recipes as design inputs only; define native contracts after authorization; reject unrelated eight-recipe presence checks; validate DAGs, terminal states and command ownership.

name: context7-mcp
rationale: Documentation retrieval discipline can use Atomic's MCP gateway; another client or extension is unnecessary.
adaptations: Require configured server and exact-version local source first; do not mistake stored ETags for HTTP revalidation; test wrong versions, stale cache, quota and unavailable evidence.

name: craft-skill
rationale: Native skill-creator, prompt-engineer and writing-for-agents already own authoring and evaluation methods.
adaptations: Retain only useful contract references; discard model pins, arbitrary line limits, absolute wording and sync; validate triggers, provenance and relative assets without editing mirrors.

name: deepen-architecture
rationale: Parent-led architecture judgment can reuse how and bounded analyzer/pattern-finder passes without mandatory fan-out.
adaptations: Resolve ADR paths and vocabulary; avoid upstream shell-policy assumptions and speculative abstractions; preserve tests until replacement behavior is proven; compare meaningful alternatives.

name: define-language
rationale: Domain terminology and ambiguity resolution are reusable conversational knowledge, not orchestration.
adaptations: Choose one parent-owned glossary consumed by model-domain; mark inferred relationships and unresolved terms; test conflicting meanings and preservation of existing content.

name: define-success
rationale: Canonical entry is a tombstone redirecting to plan-work; an optional expiring compatibility alias is its only remaining responsibility.
adaptations: Create no resource unless existing users need the alias; exclude from automatic skill selection; resolve once without competing slash registrations; preserve canonical inventory identity.

name: delegate-task
rationale: Retain task-brief and report-then-diff review guidance; native subagent dispatch and goal/ralph already own execution and bounded repair.
adaptations: Replace Agent and YAML-only context with native artifacts; inspect actual candidate including uncommitted work; no Markdown appended to YAML; acceptance does not authorize merge; test report/diff disagreement and exhausted repairs.

name: deploy
rationale: Deployment mode of a shared delivery workflow owns submission, observation, health evidence and uncertain-outcome reconciliation.
adaptations: Bind environment and immutable artifact to authorization; credentials are not approval; replace placeholders; ask only for missing authority or changed scope, preserving required gates; test timeout, unhealthy results and duplicate prevention.

name: design-interface
rationale: Software module/API alternative design is a parent-led method, not frontend styling; reuse how and optional generate-and-filter workers.
adaptations: Replace obsolete Task calls; make mandatory three-agent fan-out an explicit choice; preserve inline requests and no-implementation scope; test distinct designs and practical caller examples.

name: develop-tdd
rationale: TDD is an implementation discipline already supplied by bundled tdd; surrounding lifecycle belongs to shared execution.
adaptations: Explicitly choose evidence-based RED over mandatory red commits unless adopted; remove automatic stash/drop, commit and sync; verify intended behavioral failure and rerun same scenario after fix.

name: diagnose-root
rationale: Reproduce-isolate-hypothesize-verify is reusable debugger guidance, not a second bug lifecycle.
adaptations: Resolve bug-file ownership; allow multiple contributing causes and unresolved results; constrain diagnosis-only work explicitly; test falsified hypotheses and no speculative patching.

name: diagnose-stall
rationale: Diagnostic guidance can use native task/workflow observation; a second watchdog or idle timer duplicates Atomic.
adaptations: Distinguish user waits, quiet providers, pause and unknown telemetry; use owned task IDs; do not restart on silence or confuse cancellation request with termination; test reconnect without duplicate dispatch.

name: dispatch-agents
rationale: Keep independence and briefing criteria; native subagent parallelism and the parent already own launching and synthesis.
adaptations: Drop Orca envelopes and duplicate counters; use native results and Intercom only when needed; separate briefing depth from thinking effort; test shared-state dependencies and yielded observations.

name: edit-document
rationale: A short explicit editing recipe can reuse unslop and writing-for-agents without a dedicated worker.
adaptations: Make paragraph length optional; preserve meaning, uncertainty, links and quotations; respect read-only CHANGELOG/generated files; ask only unresolved structural decisions.

name: elaborate-spec
rationale: Human-led clarification belongs in the parent and can augment create-spec; planning consumes confirmed artifacts.
adaptations: Discover facts before asking; preserve replacement confirmation; reconcile missing written_at with consumer freshness logic; test stale context, declined replacement and no implementation.

name: enforce-first
rationale: F.I.R.S.T is a judgment rubric for tdd/audit; the test runner, not a text-presence check, provides behavioral evidence.
adaptations: Separate review from repair; state quick-mode omissions; retain project conventions; seed order dependence, flakes and missing assertions rather than checking rubric words.

name: evolve-skill
rationale: Baseline, candidate, experiment and acceptance form a maintenance workflow; skill-creator supplies authoring method.
adaptations: Blocked on valid comparative evaluation; no automatic source rollback or mirror sync; record candidate, fixtures, model, effort and samples; test inconclusive results, regressions and bound exhaustion.

name: execute-plan
rationale: Dependency execution with durable per-step human checkpoints is a mode of shared verified implementation.
adaptations: Use typed artifacts instead of YAML-only context; preserve requested step gates, stops and reordering; bound repairs and separate delivery; test pause/resume and cancelled input without advancement.

name: extract-design
rationale: Computed-style extraction and interpretation can supplement impeccable/playwright-cli; bundled helpers do not imply an extension.
adaptations: Do not port defective scripts unchanged; correct browser lifetime, spacing types, async tests and lint status; pin dependencies; replacing Puppeteer is explicit methodology adaptation; test pseudo-states and offline failures.

name: find-way
rationale: User-led decision mapping can use existing tracker/research tools; local todo is an alternative, not equivalent tracker semantics.
adaptations: Resolve conflict with upstream automated-issue ban; scope tracker mutations explicitly; remove automatic fan-out; test concurrent claims, unresolved decisions and no write from map-only requests.

name: fix-bug
rationale: Bug identity, lifecycle state, resume and validation belong to bug mode of shared verified implementation, reusing debugger and tdd.
adaptations: Remove duplicate RCA invocation and automatic release; keep concurrent bugs isolated; reproduce original user behavior; test interrupted repair, recurring failures and failed validation without shipping.

name: gate-trace
rationale: Trace policy is retained knowledge; a deterministic shared-verification reducer owns verdicts and a separate critic owns judgment.
adaptations: Resolve precedence, 60-79 percent gap, R6 and drift downgrades; missing evidence is not merge permission; truth-table combinations and keep FAIL from becoming CONCERNS.

name: generate-allure-report
rationale: An explicit shortcut can invoke deterministic status serialization; no independent model or extension is needed.
adaptations: Label story-status JUnit output as delivery reporting, not executed tests; reconcile schemas; validate XML escaping, stable IDs, malformed input and actual Allure ingestion.

name: grill-me
rationale: Interactive challenge of design assumptions belongs in the parent; reuse how/why and structured questions.
adaptations: Consolidate docs mode with grill-with-docs; distinguish discoverable facts from decisions; preserve existing authorization and genuine gates; cancellation never authorizes implementation.

name: grill-with-docs
rationale: Version-grounded challenge is a conversational method; online researchers may gather evidence but do not own user choices.
adaptations: Resolve exact lockfile versions and pinned sources; separate proposed edits from evidence gathering; test unavailable docs, wrong versions and unsupported claims.

name: guard-git
rationale: Cross-cutting pre-tool interception is genuine extension work, but no guard is the default recommendation and it is not a sandbox.
adaptations: Do not import omp-hooks; if adopted, scope tool_call to supported tools and effective cwd, remove self-exempting environment bypasses and honor existing authorization; test heredocs, Git -C, wrappers, worktrees and bypass limits.

name: harden-vps
rationale: Host-specific hardening is an opt-in runbook for occasional operations, not an Atomic event extension or fleet platform.
adaptations: Quarantine root-level defaults; establish console/key recovery before SSH/firewall changes; consistent database backups and pinned downloads; no direct auth-bypassing inserts; validate failure-aware results and restore in disposable VM.

name: hook-commits
rationale: Creating repository Git hooks is occasional setup guidance, distinct from Atomic tool-event enforcement.
adaptations: Reuse existing hooks/formatter and exact dependency versions; preserve prepare and lint-staged configuration, bun.lock and unrelated staged files; remove automatic formatting/commit; test idempotence.

name: inspect-quality
rationale: Conversational QA intake and issue splitting need parent steering; optional analyzers supply evidence without starting repairs.
adaptations: Replace Markdown masquerading as registry YAML with an agreed schema; distinguish hypotheses from verified causes; test duplicates, intermittent reproduction and logging-only scope.

name: investigate-bug
rationale: A bounded investigation-only debugger can return reproduction, verified cause and fix plan; the parent owns questions and registry writes.
adaptations: Constrain the normally edit-capable debugger; provide user-observable criteria and stable bug ID; retain source citations; falsify alternatives and report unresolved causes without patching, committing or branching.

name: kickoff-branch
rationale: VCS preparation guidance can reuse native worktree isolation rather than create another mandatory lifecycle.
adaptations: Do not switch/pull the primary checkout or auto-commit specs; repair non-atomic story locks and preflight ordering; avoid double worktrees; test dirty trees, absent remotes, lock contention and Jujutsu.

name: maintain-wiki
rationale: Optional documentation query/lint/generation guidance can reuse search/read and research-codebase; no background sync extension is justified.
adaptations: Separate read-only query/lint from broad generation; preserve generated-file prohibition; mtime is not semantic freshness; validate broken links, source deletion and explicit future output scope.

name: map-codebase
rationale: A bounded architecture report fits existing research-codebase/analyzer/pattern-finder roles; no competing mapper is needed.
adaptations: Parent owns persistence; resolve versions and commit freshness; distinguish observations from proposals; preserve domain-language content; test monorepos, missing tests and conflicting docs.

name: migrate-spec
rationale: Occasional interactive specification transformation is a method, not a permanent migration controller.
adaptations: Resolve never-overwrite versus regenerated-state conflict; preview all paths including CLAUDE.md; preserve foreign sources and active history; test partial fingerprints, ID collisions, refusal and idempotence.

name: model-domain
rationale: Parent-led invariants, state machines and terminology decisions can reuse create-spec/how/why rather than autonomous delegation.
adaptations: Choose glossary, CONTEXT, tech-stack and ADR ownership once; avoid inferring bounded contexts from file presence; test invariant counterexamples, terminology conflicts and concurrent edits.

name: orchestrate-project
rationale: An optional coordinator can compose planning, implementation and delivery for genuinely multi-phase projects.
adaptations: Replace YAML scheduler and upstream model routing; reconcile story versus project release ownership; remove unsupported timing scores; preserve inline override, existing authorization and required gates; test phase resume.

name: organize-workspace
rationale: Interactive cleanup classification and exact-path approval are reusable operational guidance, not automatic hooks.
adaptations: Preserve generated, tracked, secret and concurrent work; resolve symlinks; prefer recoverable operations; test declined/item-level decisions, partial failures and ignore rules hiding real source.

name: plan-refactor
rationale: Invariant discovery and green-step planning can augment create-spec/how; proposing commits does not execute them.
adaptations: Keep source evidence instead of blanket path bans; avoid clobbering LATEST plans; characterize untested behavior; require runnable verification and no implicit branch/commit action.

name: plan-release
rationale: Release-index composition is planning method; plan-work owns detailed tasks and the planning workflow owns sequencing.
adaptations: Resolve index-builder/task-writer contradiction; make capsules, BCP, 20 sections and semantic-release explicit choices; test stable IDs and dependency-safe priority ordering without publishing.

name: plan-tests
rationale: Scenario architecture, test levels and fixtures are reusable planning knowledge; reuse tdd/create-spec and project patterns.
adaptations: Fix scenario-ID mismatch and hardcoded e32 verification; no silent NFR waiver under lite; use exact stack versions; verify acceptance coverage and no implementation during planning.

name: plan-work
rationale: Detailed plan quality is reusable method inside planning, supported by create-spec and targeted analyzers.
adaptations: Reconcile task states and capsule schemas; remove model/timing/handoff control; validate active capsule rather than first sorted file; distinguish command syntax, runnability and actual behavioral evidence.

name: publish-package
rationale: Registry mode of shared delivery owns irreversible publication, receipt verification and uncertain-outcome reconciliation.
adaptations: Remove TestPyPI upload from dry-run, no-verify and changelog edits; bind package/version/registry/visibility/artifact to authorization; no repeated approval for covered actions; preserve required gates; test duplicate and partial publication.

name: quick-fix
rationale: An explicit constrained fast-path shortcut is enough; current session owns work and reusable eligibility belongs with bug guidance.
adaptations: Remove automatic commit/amend/release; data-only can still be high risk; require before/after reproduction and nonzero failure exit; preserve inline choice and unrelated dirty files.

name: release-branch
rationale: Branch integration combines external and destructive actions requiring a distinct delivery owner, not automatic continuation from verification.
adaptations: No solo default or force-removal; require authorization coverage for commit/push/PR/merge/tag/publish/cleanup, asking only if missing or scope changes while preserving required gates; fix CI false success and reconcile unknown outcomes; test covered multi-action approval without redundant prompts.

name: request-review
rationale: Independent fan-out, aggregation and bounded repair are workflow responsibilities; fresh reviewers are secondary workers.
adaptations: Reuse native review compositions without silently replacing acceptance semantics; resolve three/five rounds and undefined 94 percent denominator; use criterion evidence/vetoes; test one reviewer failing, missing reports and stale candidates.

name: research-first
rationale: Prior-art adopt/extend/compose/build selection is method already supported by research-codebase and native research tools.
adaptations: Use exact-version OSS checkouts instead of opportunistic opensrc/npx; native skill catalog replaces index generation; preserve valid artifacts and report unavailable evidence without installation.

name: reset-baseline
rationale: An explicit infrequent workspace operation needs a shortcut, not a new reset agent or lifecycle.
adaptations: Stash changes workspace and omits ignored files; preserve all work and separate setup installs; benchmarks use owned disposable checkouts; test refusal, partial stash, restoration and submodules.

name: respond-review
rationale: Feedback disposition and repair discipline belong to a method used inside the existing review loop.
adaptations: Reproduce disputed defects; preserve original acceptance criteria; account for every finding with fix/disagree/defer; rerun checks on final candidate; no inferred commit/merge authority.

name: run-benchmark
rationale: Controlled comparative agent experiments require isolated runs, immutable artifacts and deterministic grading, unlike the supplied runner.
adaptations: Reject fabricated test -f /dev/null control and PASS-text overriding exit status; run real with/without conditions, grade stored outputs once and correct pass@k terminology; test negative controls, missing rubrics and regression exits.

name: run-evals
rationale: Evaluation design and stability criteria are reusable knowledge; existing verification tools/workflows own repetitions.
adaptations: Correct success-rate/all-k/pass@k terminology; retain trials and flakes; calibrate graders and tier transitions; required failed or missing runs cannot become model-scored success.

name: run-planning
rationale: Resumable discovery steps, optional branches and handoffs require one native planning owner.
adaptations: Resolve fresh-project versus registered-epic prerequisite; replace YAML cursor and wall-clock-only freshness; retain confirmed context; test partial resume, declined branches and stale approvals without repeated work.

name: scope-work
rationale: Goal, exclusions and observable requirements are planning method supplied through create-spec and parent questions.
adaptations: Preserve existing answers and artifacts; resolve product/requirements layout; allow deferred IDs; validate observability and mapping without forcing Bigpowers YAML.

name: search-skills
rationale: Native catalog owns discovery; at most a user shortcut should recommend a matching loaded resource.
adaptations: Remove generated index, model-field routing and automatic invocation; test source-qualified collisions, disabled/untrusted resources, reload and no-match cases.

name: security-review
rationale: Independent bounded security assessment benefits from fresh context; parent owns exceptions, remediation and delivery authority.
adaptations: Remove blanket prompt-injection/docs/ReDoS/Rust exclusions; preserve uncertain high-impact concerns; bind base/head/uncommitted diff; correct unsafe examples; test agent injection, path-prefix collisions, unsafe FFI and pre-code threat modeling.

name: seed-conventions
rationale: Interactive convention authoring can reuse writing-for-agents; it must not become automatic bootstrap policy.
adaptations: Infer existing commands first; preserve handwritten sections, symlinks and settings; no empty placeholders or silent solo/no-direct-coding doctrine; validate exact output scope and read-only files.

name: session-state
rationale: Native session persistence, compaction, todo and workflow checkpoints replace scheduling; retain handoff hygiene only.
adaptations: No second state scheduler or automatic AGENTS/CLAUDE edits; one writer for optional advisory export; preserve unresolved decisions and authorization through resume/compaction; test field conflicts and concurrent writers.

name: setup-environment
rationale: Project-native setup guidance is reusable method, not a persistent setup controller.
adaptations: Setup and package lifecycle execution must be in scope; never overwrite env files or expose secrets; omit big-counter unless adopted; test offline, missing locks, runtime mismatch and partial install.

name: simple-english
rationale: Substantial STE guidance and references justify an optional method alongside unslop and writing-for-agents.
adaptations: Opt in to STE; preserve modal strength, uncertainty, code and quotations; retain third-party notices and dictionary boundary; distinguish heuristic lint from compliance; test missing Vale and strict/pragmatic modes.

name: simulate-agents
rationale: Coordinating Mock User and Auditor with aggregation is an optional branch of shared verification, not one subagent.
adaptations: Use fresh bounded role contexts and immutable scenario inputs; distinguish hypothetical simulation from observed browser/terminal tests; test failure routing and no production approval from simulation.

name: slice-tasks
rationale: Vertical slicing is planning knowledge; native workflow dependencies and todo own scheduling/status.
adaptations: Resolve 1-13 shortcut versus element-sum BCP; make sizing optional and calibrated, not time; validate end-to-end value, IDs, acyclic dependencies and requirement deltas.

name: smoke-test
rationale: HTTP verification guidance uses deterministic project tools; delivery owns any post-deploy gate.
adaptations: Invocation never authorizes deployment; fix ignored HTTP method and uncounted successful status assertions; default to authorized non-mutating requests; test URL overrides, DNS, timeout, content and empty config.

name: spike-prototype
rationale: Timeboxed experiment discipline can use an optional worker in owned scratch space without a permanent controller.
adaptations: Prototype scope does not waive secrets/security/permissions; retain evidence and unknown outcomes; no automatic production integration or unowned deletion; validate timebox and original-file preservation.

name: stocktake-skills
rationale: Catalog-wide inventory, partitioned audit and synthesis fit one maintenance workflow using native fan-out when useful.
adaptations: Audit verify commands before execution; presence is not content equality and missing telemetry is not zero usage; no automatic archive/fix; validate exact inventory, mirror drift and safe read-only audit.

name: survey-context
rationale: Context selection is method; native session/workflow status replaces lifecycle inference and mandatory startup scripts.
adaptations: Read RULES/AGENTS first; no state initialization for status requests; preserve Git/Jujutsu semantics and dynamic recommendation; remove stale ship-epic alias; test no-spec and contradictory-state projects.

name: terse-mode
rationale: Explicit communication preference belongs to the current session, not expertise or independent model routing.
adaptations: Reuse concise normal language and unslop; preserve uncertainty and safety warnings; no unsupported 75-percent savings claim or cross-session settings change; test normal-mode reset.

name: trace-requirement
rationale: Trace interpretation is method; deterministic extraction supplies evidence to shared verification.
adaptations: Tags establish claimed provenance, not correct behavior; align IDs and scope denominator; preserve generated ownership; test missing/orphan tags, stale evidence and false filename matches.

name: using-bigpowers
rationale: Onboarding is optional explicit help; native catalogs should replace mandatory session-start methodology injection.
adaptations: Remove automatic setup and solo landing; describe adopted methods and departures honestly; use actual inventory; test help-only invocation with unchanged settings and inline preference.

name: validate-contracts
rationale: Contract design and interpretation are reusable knowledge; project schema/API tests own deterministic validation.
adaptations: Resolve subset direction, unsupported modes and consumer root; replace unsafe text parsing/path interpolation; required unsupported checks cannot pass; test nested keys, malformed data and exact/subset semantics.

name: validate-fix
rationale: Bug acceptance and defect-class sweep criteria are method; shared bug workflow owns bounded repair.
adaptations: Use explicit bug ID and final candidate; remove unchosen RED/GREEN commit requirement; parse sweep evidence rather than field-name strings; test original behavior despite green unit tests, stale evidence and concurrent bugs.

name: verify-work
rationale: Multiphase checks, UAT checkpoints and bounded repair belong to shared implementation verification.
adaptations: Resolve mandatory versus risk-skipped UAT explicitly; preserve required project checks; use owned processes, not pkill/cache deletion; bind receipts to final candidate; test red gates, honest skips and resume.

name: visual-dashboard
rationale: Live status projection is extension work only if native workflow status/graph and show-me leave a demonstrated gap.
adaptations: Prefer no port; optional observer never schedules; reconcile capsule schema, authorized project paths, origins/auth and event writes; dispose subscriptions/processes; test unavailable versus idle and no automatic handoff.

name: wire-ci
rationale: Occasional repository CI setup is method, not Atomic runtime event handling; reuse project CI and validators.
adaptations: Preserve existing workflows; use explicit consumer root; reconcile unsupported validate/dry-run flags; gh workflow run is remote execution; test no overwrite, unsupported forge and no accidental release permissions.

name: wire-observability
rationale: Application logging and health instrumentation are implementation methods, not agent event extensions.
adaptations: Reuse exact-version logging stack; reconcile userId with no-PII policy; validate useful boundary coverage, redaction and error paths; check-then-create setup needs real concurrency/idempotence tests.

name: write-document
rationale: Artifact-purpose and durable writing guidance can reuse unslop/writing-for-agents/how/why without another scheduler.
adaptations: Preserve uncertainty; remove arbitrary 94-percent claims, compaction limits, placeholders and GEMINI indexes; no generated/CHANGELOG edits or sync; validate factual claims, links, examples and target purpose.
